en: Colorized postcard view of a riverside scene showing a large historic building or small castle on a rocky hill above the water. Terraced slopes and trees lead down to the riverbank. In the foreground a long paddle steamer travels along the river. On the left are several smaller houses and farm buildings. The sky is lightly clouded with a pastel pink and blue tint. At the top left, German text identifies the location.
